title: dep-scan mcp scan_summary output
description: The document the scan_summary tool of `depscan mcp` returns: the scan directory's manifest in summary form and the counts of its findings by category and severity. A directory that cannot be read as a scan is a tool error, never an empty summary; a missing tool or a skipped stage shows up in the stage counts instead of being hidden.

scanDir.description: The scan directory that was summarised, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform.

manifestSummary.description: The manifest's summary. Null when the directory holds no manifest and was read through the older VDR-only layout.

findingCount.description: The number of findings in the scan directory's depscan.findings.json.

countsByCategory.description: The findings counted by category, using the finding schema's category values. Every category with at least one finding is present; a category with no findings is absent.

countsBySeverity.description: The findings counted by severity, using the finding schema's severity values. Every severity with at least one finding is present; a severity with no findings is absent.

layoutVersion.description: The scan directory layout version the manifest records, as major.minor.

depscanVersion.description: The version of dep-scan that ran the scan.

startUtc.description: When the scan started, in UTC, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

endUtc.description: When the scan ended, in UTC, as an RFC 3339 date-time. A scan that stopped early still records its end.

items.description: One project type the stages ran for, in first-seen stage order.

projectTypes.description: The project types the scan ran for, from the stages' projectType fields, each listed once.

stageCount.description: The number of stage entries the manifest records, check stages included.

stagesByStatus.description: The stages counted by status, using the manifest's stage status values. Every status with at least one stage is present; a status with no stages is absent.

inputCount.description: The number of inputs the manifest records.

fileCount.description: The number of files the manifest records.
